dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL with VSAM KSDS files, RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, RETURN-CODE special register, GOBACK, and DD-name file assignments (DDMAE, DDNOV, DDSAL). Spanish-language comments suggest Latin American mainframe environment.
evidence: ASSIGN DDMAE / DDNOV / DDSAL (JCL DD-name style)

purpose.domain_detail: Customer master file balance update — merges a novedad (transaction/update) file against a VSAM KSDS customer master file and writes updated balances to an output VSAM file.
purpose.summary: PGMAPA99 is a batch balance-update program that matches a sequential novedad (transaction) file against a VSAM KSDS customer master file using a merge/match algorithm. For each matching key it accumulates the transaction balance (WS-NOV-SALDO) and writes the updated record to an output VSAM file. It also calls an external date-validation routine (PGMRUT).

notable_features: VSAM KSDS indexed files with FILE STATUS
DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (European/Latin American numeric convention)
LINKAGE SECTION with date parameter passed from caller
CALL to external routine PGMRUT for date processing
RETURN-CODE special register for error signalling
HIGH-VALUE sentinel used for end-of-file on keyed files
Sequential merge/match algorithm on two input files
